name: Aldeilla sin FMC Open 2023

venue.name: Centro Cultural de Santa María del Águila

information: # ![Image description](https://i.imgur.com/xmhpUQf.jpg) **Español** Los socios AES tendrán un descuento del 15%, el cuál se reembolsará tras la realización del campeonato. **IMPORTANTE:** Esta competición comparte sede con el FMC Spanish Championship 2023, pero ambas competiciones son independientes. Si quieres participar en ambas, tienes que registrarte en ambas por separado. Más información en la pestaña dedicada al [FMC Spanish Championship 2023 .](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AldeillasinFMCOpen2023#32673-fmc-spanish-championship-2023) # ![Image description](https://i.imgur.com/whUqn2n.jpg) **English** AES members will have a 15% discount, which will be refunded after the competition. **IMPORTANT:** This competition shares a location with FMC Spanish Championship 2023. However, both are considered independent competitions. If you want to participate in both, you need to register for both separately. More information in the [FMC Spanish Championship 2023 tab.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AldeillasinFMCOpen2023#32673-fmc-spanish-championship-2023)
